distanceField.packing: 16-bit signed distance in RG; original raster coverage in B; opaque A
distanceField.construction: Synchronous exact SVG Path2D rasterization and a cached pixel-grid Euclidean distance transform.
distanceField.intentionalDifference: Sampled distance approximation with antialias-aware boundary handling; not an analytic Bezier distance.

studies.name: Pigment relief
studies.description: The existing Monarchic mark becomes a shallow dimensional pigment relief with limited-palette tonal dithering.
studies.framerPlacementStatus: pending Framer creation and editor-reload verification
intentionalDifferences: The canonical planar geometry is projected as a shallow rounded extrusion with stylized light and pigment coverage.
The tonal palette and ordered screen texture are authored material treatments, not physical print simulation.

studies.name: Optical counterform
studies.description: Distance contours radiate through and around the canonical mark while preserving its diagonal counterform.
studies.framerPlacementStatus: pending Framer creation and editor-reload verification
intentionalDifferences: Distance bands extend beyond the original silhouette; the mark remains the source of the field and its diagonal negative space stays open.
Line pitch and integrated coverage adapt to image resolution rather than preserving one fixed screen-space stripe count.

studies.name: Chrome cut
studies.description: A rounded extrusion of the existing mark reflects an authored studio-light field and localized spectral color.
studies.framerPlacementStatus: pending Framer creation and editor-reload verification
intentionalDifferences: Extrusion, studio reflections and spectral accents are authored approximations rather than a physically traced metal material.
Normals are smoothed from the sampled distance grid; subtle grid-derived sidewall striations remain at close inspection.

studies.name: Phosphor carrier
studies.description: Layered pixel-light samples of the existing mark carry a moving signal along its diagonal cut.
studies.framerPlacementStatus: pending Framer creation and editor-reload verification
intentionalDifferences: Layered offsets and pixel-light samples soften and multiply the canonical silhouette as an original signal treatment.
Emission, scanning and the traveling highlight are authored screen effects rather than a physical phosphor simulation.
